title: Testing ∂C = 0 against df for a 1-current given by densities along rays (parent step 1)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let C ∈ 𝒟_1(ℝ^P) (a GeometricCurrentOn univ 1) satisfy ∂C = 0 (C.boundary = 0). Let F be a finite subset of ℝ^P and G : ℝ^P → ℝ → ℝ an arbitrary function. Suppose that C(ω) = Σ_{e∈F} ∫_{(0,∞)} G(e)(t)·ω(te)(fun _ => e) dt for every test 1-form ω ∈ 𝒟¹(ℝ^P). Then for every C^∞ function f : ℝ^P → ℝ with compact support, Σ_{e∈F} ∫_{(0,∞)} G(e)(t)·deriv (s ↦ f(s·e))(t) dt = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1), C.boundary = 0 → ∀ (F : Finset (Euclid P)) (G : Euclid P → ℝ → ℝ), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, C ω = ∑ e ∈ F, ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), G e t * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) 1) (t • e) (fun _ => e)) → ∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) f → HasCompactSupport f → ∑ e ∈ F, ∫ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), G e t * deriv (fun s : ℝ => f (s • e)) t = 0
